extDescription.message: Lets the PageSquire assistant of a site you allow use real clicks and typing. Development build: local and .test sites only.

devBuild.message: Development build: it only works on local and .test sites.

noSite.message: This tab is not a local or .test site, so the companion cannot act here.

manifestError.message: This site has no valid PageSquire declaration:

allowHelp.message: The site's assistant will be able to read this page and the frames listed, and click, type and press keys there with real input. Password, payment and one-time-code fields stay yours.

acting.message: The assistant is acting in this tab.

idle.message: The assistant is not acting now.

stopped.message: Stopped in this tab. The assistant uses the page's own input until you resume.

stopHelp.message: Press Esc in the page or Stop here to end it at any time.

framesRefused.message: Not allowed in frames (payment, sign-in or not a local site):

framesAllowed.message: Also reads and acts in these frames:

share.message: Share this tab with the assistant

sharedTabs.message: Tabs shared with this page’s assistant:

memberOf.message: This tab is shared with the assistant as

screenshots.message: Allow redacted screenshots of this site

screenshotsHelp.message: The assistant may then take a picture of the visible page to check its work. Form fields, private areas and frames are blacked out first. Off by default.
